tools: **Tools.** This method calls the FlowLeap patent tools by name. In the FlowLeap Patent AI app the office tools are built in; `patent_analytics`, `get_fulltext` and the `patstat_*` tools are FlowLeap Data tools, named `mcp__flowleap__<name>`, which exist only when the firm or the user has FlowLeap Data. With the FlowLeap connector in another client, call the connector tool of the same name. When `get_claims` answers that it has no US source, call the tool that its answer names.
missingKeys: **Missing keys.** When a tool answers that an office's key is not configured or that the office rejected the stored key, that office is a user-action stop, never an exhausted route: finish the work with the other offices, name the gap in the result as a missing-key gap (not as "no results"), never fill it with data from the web, and at the end tell the user which key is missing or rejected. On the desktop app the user adds it in Settings > Patent data connectors; on the firm OS the firm administrator sets the keys, so tell the attorney to ask the administrator; in another client, relay the page that the tool's answer names. Never ask for a key value in the chat.
